# Real palm image fixtures

These fixtures are real photographs used only to exercise image decoding, EXIF orientation, upload size/format validation, and the mocked vision integration path. The tests do not call an external vision model or infer medical facts from the images.

## `palm_hand.jpg`

Source: [Wikimedia Commons — File:Palm hand.JPG](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Palm_hand.JPG)  
Original file: `https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7e/Palm_hand.JPG`  
Author: Cvmontuy  
License: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)  
Changes: the test fixture is a byte-for-byte downloaded copy of the original file; no edits were made.

The source page identifies the file as a 2,592 × 1,728 JPEG and grants reuse under CC BY-SA 3.0. The fixture is not used as evidence of any person's health, identity, or future.
